% Fixture for BUG-16: \par inserted inside math display environments
% _strip_par_in_groups() removes \par tokens at brace depth > 0, but does
% NOT track \begin{...}...\end{...} environment depth. A blank line inside
% \begin{gather}...\end{gather} (or align, equation, etc.) becomes \par
% after preprocessing step 3, and \par inside math mode causes:
% "! Paragraph ended before \gather was complete."
%
% Playground verified: compile fails with \par inside gather.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\begin{document}
\begin{gather}
A \to B
\label{eq:example}
\end{gather}
\end{document}
